stops.note: to carry before, to prefer, from prae- (before) and ferre (to carry), with irregular past participle praelatus
carried into French for a high-ranking church official, one preferred above others
settled as the English word for a high-ranking clergyman
stops.meaning: a high-ranking clergyman, such as a bishop

current_meaning: a high-ranking member of the clergy, such as a bishop
